summary: Feed c040_crc to SIEM is degraded due to high physical-layer errors on NPB-01 port 1/1. 56,880 CRC/alignment damaged frames (error rate 0.004442) will cause corrupted/dropped traffic to SIEM.

findings.root_cause: NPB-01 port 1/1 (input) received 56,880 damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors exceeding threshold (0.004442 > 0.00001), indicating faulty cable/optic or duplex mismatch on the link into the packet broker
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM receives corrupted and truncated frames that will be dropped by NIC/broker; results in missing events/flows, incomplete log correlation and reduced detection coverage even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional traffic

recommended_fix.why: Physical layer must be clean before any broker policy can help - replace cable/optic, verify duplex/speed negotiation, and re-check optics on NPB-01 1/1 to eliminate CRC errors at ingress
